name: Golan
brief: A city of refuge in Bashan, allotted to Manasseh.
short: Golan was a city of refuge in Bashan, allotted to the Levites of the family of Gershon and located in the territory of the half-tribe of Manasseh (<ref="Deu.4.43; Joshua 20:8; 21:27; 1Ch.6.71">Deu.4.43; Joshua 20:8; 21:27; 1Ch.6.71</ref>).
